༄༅/ /chos kyi rje mtshungs med grags pa rgya mtsho'i rnam thar me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje mtshungs med grags pa rgya mtsho'i rnam thar

me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / gang zhig dbyings las mi g.yo gdod ma'i mgon/ /rang byung lha ni kun bzang yab yum dang*/ /rdo rje 'chang sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs lhag pa'i lha/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol bar chad sol/ /bdag nyid dad pa'i yid rab g.yos pa las/ /dad ldan slob ma'i dang ba 'dren byed du/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar mdo tsam bri/ /de la nongs pa mchis na bzod mdzad rigs/ /de la 'dir bdag gi bla ma dam pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid/ dang po yul mchog tu gyur pa rigs rus kyi che bar sku bzhes tshul/ gzhon nu'i tshe nas chos kyi skal ba yod tshul/ de'i stobs kyis chos kyi sgor chud tshul/ de las mkhas grub kyi bla ma bsten tshul/ de rnams las dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom pa mdzad tshul/ de nas grwa bu slob dang sems can spyi la phan pa mdzad tshul/ bar chad dang log 'dren btul tshul/ yi dam lha'i snang ba thob tshul/ bla ma rnams kyis lung bstan thob tshul/ tha ma dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs tshul sogs don bcus bstan pa las/ dang po ltar na/ yul ni dam chos dar zhing dge bcu la spyod pa'i gnas gra gtso bo grong*/ yab ni kun dga' 'bum zhes 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nas brgyud pa'i 'brom gyi rigs/ snye mo gzhu kun dga' ra ba ka ba brgyad cu'i bdag po bu re skyes pa dang 'bum tshar re bzhengs/ gtsug lag der gdan 'dren rab gnas bu'i rkang tshugs byed pas/ ming la 'bum zhes pa'ang de yin par 'dug / yum ni sangs rgyas rin chen gyi bu mo bsam 'grub 'bum gnyis las/ sras ni gsum yodapa las/ drung pa nyid 'bring por 'khrungs par 'dug /gnyis pa ltar na/ sku na gzhon nu'i dus nas/ chos la mos pa dad pa nges 'byung yod pas ser gzugs la dga' ba/

ma ṇi sogs zhal 'don phran tshe ga la brtson pa/ khyad par yi ge 'bri klog la thugs song nas/ slob dpon las klog rgyu ma byung na'ang*/ nged rang gi drung pha khu pha jo la ka kha 'bri nus gang shes bslabs/ de nas dpa ེ chos shog tshal ba dang yan pa khyer nas las ka'i zhar la bslabs pas brda' 'jol ba byung gsungs/ jo bo che ba hor 'dra byed pas yi ge la nan du bslabs/ bdag gis g.yog gi zhar la bslabs pa ma gtogs ma byung ste/ zhar grab tsam byung bas/ a mas kyang kho bos zhar la byas pa 'di drag pa 'dug zer nas/ nga rang slob bcug /jo jo la g.yog 'chol ba yang du mar re byas dus/ de rnams kyi gzugs kyag kyog bris pas dum pa shes/ steng du jo jo yi ge slob par btang nas/ bdag gis rtsam pa la phyin pas/ jo jo yul du bros 'dug /nga rang gis khyer ba'i rtsam pa ma zad bar zhang po las yi ge bslabs/ zhag brgyad bsdad/ de nas zhang po la rtsam pa skyis sdod bsam pa/ a mas 'thab dogs yul la phyin/ dpe cha 'bri thub tsam pa'i yi ge 'di de yin gsungs/ gsum pa ltar na zhang po la btsun pa gcig byed bsam pa yin byas pas/ de ga drag zer/ nga rang yang blo yul du de kha bcangs na'ang*/ ma skyur ma phod pa dang*/ nu bo yang chung*/ jo jo nang sor bsdad pas/ mas gang yang mi lcogs par 'dug pas lo gnyis 'gyangs/ de nas 'di tsho la zin pa'i dus mi 'dug /tig po med/ nga rang chos la 'gro bsam/ yo byad 'dra ba lkog tu mtshon pa bsags/ jo jo la gros shig 'debs dgos bsam dol gzhis khar phyin pas/ gros med pa'i steng du/ ngu zhing 'di'adra phod pa zer/ mi shi ba khad zer nas/ nga'i phyi la yun ring du byung*/ ma byed zer bas/ gdong du de kha lags byas/ khong dang bral nas thag ring du song nas khyod la tig tig med/ nga rang btsun pa rang byed bsam/ de nas yul du sleb a ma jo jo 'di skad zer/ khyod ci bsam pa yin / ngas ni chos shig dang 'phrad na rang la dga' zhing khyod la'ang phan thogs pa yong zer ba sogs khe nyen mang du lab kyang nga shi ba khad zer zhing ngu ba yang byed pas/

khyod 'byung med ma zhig 'dug /nga 'gro bla ma de ni sangs rgyas dngos yin/ khyod rang yang btsun ma byed na sang shog byas/ ma dang gnyen bshes la 'dun pa bor ro/ / tshe 'di la phyi mig ma bltas par yong dus/ sgor slebs pas nang so drung byang sems bu 'dren dpal ba de/ thugs la 'dogs pas rib tsam mdzad mjal du 'gro bsam/ phyi nas 'di ltar 'gro zhus pas/ mi drag a ma nyen mo snying rje gsungs/ cis kyang 'gro ba'i lam yin/ a ma yang gzhan byas pa ni min chos byas nas snying mi rje zhus pas/ 'o na chos mgo thon par gyis/ 'di la 'thud gyis gsung snam bu gcig ja sbyor gnyis tsam zhig gos kha gang rnams gnang byung de tsho yar khyer phyin/ byams sdings su slebs pa tsam gyis sems la dga' ba dpag du med pa byung*/ de dgongs zhang pos snyan zhus phul/ sang zhogs de/ nga rang gi lo nyi shu rtsa gsum byi ba lo zla ba yar ngo'i gral tshes bzang po la/ mkhan slob sprul sku rin po che dang*/ 'khrul zhig rin po che rnam gnyis dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i drung du rab tu byung ste/ ming yang mtshan gnyis ka nas sbyar te/ grags pa rgya mtsho zhes gnang bas/ dus de nas 'jig rten la spro ba bcad / dam pa chos kyi sgor tshud pa yin gsung*/ khyed tsho chos byed pa la gegs med par byas chog pa dga' bo rang yin/ slob gnyer gzhan la 'bungs/ nga btsun pa byed pa la dka' ba de tsam byung gsung*/ bzhi pa ltar na rtsa ba'i bla ma mthar thug zhen che zhing*/ gtsug gi nor bu bzhugs pa rin po che sprul sku ba/ 'khrul zhig rin po che bya btang chos rje gu yangs yan pa blo bde/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rin chen chos rje grags don pa/ mkhas grub pad+ma bzang po rnams yin gsungs/ nged rang yang de go rgyun gyi phyag mchod bsdus pa tsam la/ de rnams la mdzad pa 'dug pas/ gzhan yang chos kyi rje rin po che bsod nams bzang po sogs kyis khrid ma bu tshang bar gnang bas grol ba cher thong ba dang*/

rtogs ldan rin chen dkon mchog rdo rje la sogs kyis zhen med kyi spyod pas blo sna 'gyur ba dang*/ chos rje bkras dpal sogs la gsang sngags kyi dbang bka' dang*/ pha rol phyin pa'i lung sna 'ga' zung gis 'brel ba'i bla ma dam pa mang du yod pa zhabs tog gsum gyis mnyes par byas nas bsten pa yin gsung*/ zhabs tog gsum la sgrub pa'i zhabs tog nyams len sgom pa mdzad pa'i skabs su 'byung ba lags/ yo byad kyis mnyes pa cher ma byung na'ang*/ bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog /bla ma'i bka' drin gsob byed pha ma'i drin lan khel byed nged rang gi dge sbyor gyi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir du/ dang po la bsod snyoms byas pa'i nas mtshon pa gcig la brten/ byams sdings su khrid chen mo'i tshogs ma bu phyag rten gang 'os dang bcas pa chos rje rin po che zhang dbon pas gtso mdzad/ chos zhu phyed dang nyis brgya tsam la zhus/ dang po chos zhu ba'i rkang byas / gzhan pa'i rgyu cha rkyen gyis lcogs kyang snying gis mchun pa dka' tsam byung ba la/ bdag gis byas pas bla ma mched grogs dang bcas shin tu mnyes mgo legs te/ rting du mang du byas chog pa byung gsung*/ rin po che grags don pas gra thang du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bstan 'gyur dang bcas pa gnang dus chos nyan rnams la tshogs 'khor gcig gnyis dang gzims khang du gdan mang du zhus/ drung du na bza' sogs 'bul bas mnyes par byas/ de nas dpal sdings su phebs/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gnang dus dbang zhu rnams la'ang*/ dbang khral gyi dad bskul mtshon pa bsdus/ nged rang gi gzhi gang 'dug blangs dus/ dang po 'dzugs ston bzang po gcig byas/ dbang zhag re tshogs dang*/ thon pa'i nyin tshogs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ drung du dbu zhwa na bza'/ snam bu 'jam po sogs dgu tshan/ nas rgyab dgu sha khog bcu gcig mar dum gcig rnams phul/ gangs khrod dgon par gsang sngags gsar snying gi rgyud 'bum gnyis gnang dus rgyud mchod tshogs 'bul ba sogs zhus/

yang de gar rgyud snga phyi bar gsum gyi chos zhus dus kyang 'bul ba tshogs rnams zhus/ mdor na chos dbang gdams pa gang dang ci la gang 'tshams kyi 'bul ba dbang ston chos ston grogs mched rnams la tshogs phal cher byas/ bya btang byas dus nged rang la byed rgyu med par phan gzan bkal ba yang dum bu byung gsung*/ gzhan yang dbon po chos dpal dang dag dbang rnam rgyal spun gnyis kyi bshad gsar sogs la nga rang gi rgyu rnams bton/ rtse thang du mar ja stong tshad 'bul ba sogs lan gnyis dang*/ gra thang byams gling rnams su tshar 'gyed dang bcas pa re byas/ rta ི nga du nged rang gi thab kyang 'gros sgo ches pa dang*/ skyong dgos kyang mang bas len ma gtogs/ chos phyogs la gtong ba'i 'dod chen po yod de dka' mo 'dug gsung*/ dang po de dus nga rang gi kha min pa skyong dgos med pas pha ma la yang yog mi yong tsam byas/ a ma 'das dus ma shi tsam nas dmigs pa dang 'pho ba gang shes yod/ shi nas de ma thag gsung sgrogs pa bzhag /dkon mchog la mchod pa phul/ dgon pa nas gang dgos kyi yo byad blangs/ jo jo nye ring gi ma slebs gong du bla ma mchod gnas sogs bzang rags spyan drangs/ 'das nas zhag gsum song dus cho ga tshugs zhag lnga sbrel tsam du byas / yul mi dang dgon pa nas dge 'dun rnams la 'gyed mi la mi 'chor ba zha ི ga byas/ bdun tshig zla mchod sogs nga rang gi sa bzung nas ma chags tsam lo mchod rten bzhengs tshun chad la bcom ldan 'das sman bla'i pho brang dar cha dang tshon gyis ngoms pa 'di bzhengs pa yin/ sde pa chen po min pa gzhan gyis 'dad dang cha lang dka' gsung*/ bla ma rnams gshegs rjes su dus mchod re tsam 'dzin pa/ o rgyan gyi tshes bcu re byed pa nged rang gi dgon pa phan tshun du sgrub mchod re gso ba/ ma ṇi ba rnams la tsha ba re 'dren pa sogs gang lcogs kyi dge ba dang*/ bla ma'i phyogs la gtong pas/ mi ci bsam kyang*/

nged rang blo bde ba dang 'phral yang skyid par byung gsung*/ bdag gis kyang tsag tsag cug mdzad kyang mdzad pa che ba la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i thugs shogs che ba gsungs pa bzhin yin par go /lus ngag gi zhabs tog la spyir gyi bla ma'i zhabs tog la dgen bcu da ma byas/ khyad par gang gis gsung pa la gsung bcag pa med/ de las kyang byams sdings sogs su nang pa'i 'dren 'gugs dgongs pa rnams la rgyags pa dang*/ dang gdos pa'i dpe thub pa byas/ bya gtang chos rje'i thugs bzhed la 'tshar gcig bzhed 'dug pas/ bsod snyoms byas nas gang des bsgrubs nas 'bul dgos bsam/ 'phan yul du btsal bas ma rnyed/ byang stag lung du 'gro dgos byung yang dam bca' mthar skyel bsam ste btsal bas rnyed de phul bas thugs mnyes par byung bla ma gang mnyes de lag na yod na 'bul/ med na btsal nas rin gyis bslu ba dad pa can la 'dug na bskul ba sogs byas pa yin gsung yang rdzong du khrid ka gsung pa la phyag dpe skyid smad du lus nas med gsung pa la/ gzhan ma rnams a mdo ba sogs kyis lam la 'jigs nas 'gro zer ba ma byung*/ chos thugs rjes 'dzin na ngas 'gro zhus pas/ de la zla'o gcig dgos gsung mi dgos zhus pas/ gzhan ma drang yang yod gsung nged gnyis phyin phyag dpe rnams ngas khur khos dar dang sha dang lo chas rtsam pa rnams khur yar yong dus/ bye ma klung grong du rta pa bcu dang thug /rgyug pa ring po gcig yod pas rta'i sna gong la brgyab ste gdong blangs/ kho 'bros su bcug pas tshad nas 'bros pa yang ma byung bar 'gyel nas lus te/ dra ba na gang 'dug dang lus chas kyang shor/ ngas rta pa gnyis gan rkyal sgyel ba ri zur de la 'dzegs pas phyag dpe rnams drangs te/ drung du lo rgyus zhus pa/ gos rnams ngas khur gzhan ma khong la bskur na 'tshengs pa zhus pas/ nyid de/ 'di ka go bcad gzhan ma rnams shor kyang nga'i dpe cha ma shor ba legs gsung mnyes pa cher mdzad/

de la sogs te bla ma'i gsung byung na phyis kyang mi dor bar phyin pa mang gsung*/ gzhan rten gsum bzhengs pa/ gung thang dang*/ gra thang dang*/ zhong stengs sogs kyi mchod rten zhig gad gsos byed pa la lus kyis gang lcogs 'bungs pas sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags re tsam byung ba yod gsung*/ ngas ni gang gsung bsgrubs pa las/ bla ma'i bka' gcog ma myong*/ khyed tshos bla ma'i bka' bcag na skyid po mi yong gsung*/ lnga pa ltar na bla ma rnams las gdams ngag thob tshul gsan yig ltar lags/ nyid kyis thos bsam la sbyangs pa mdzad tshul ni/ nga rgan zhugs lta bu yin pas 'dzin yong rgyu med/ dang po rdzogs chen gyi gtor ma chos spyod gsol 'debs/ bla ma'i las byang chos skyong bskang gso/ zhi khro'i bsgom khog don phrin/ bskang bshags rnams nyin nub kha sbyar te bzung nas bslabs/ de nas spyod 'jug /theg gsum gsal byed rnams blo la chu rgyug pa 'dra byas/ don yang gang shes go bar bslabs/ rdor dbyings lag len/ sa chog rgyas pa/ mchod gar la sogs cha lag tshang ba dang*/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma / lha dgu ma / kun rig gzhan phan 'od zer cha lag dang bcas rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub mchod byed lugs rgyas pa/ bde mchog lu hi pa rnams kha yod lag yod tsam du bslabs pa yin gsung*/ gzhan yang sman lha kaṃ ka ni sogs zab chos dang*/ bsnyung gnas chos skyong skor lag len dang*/ mdo phran tshegs sman dpyad skor phan bya dang sgra'i mtshams sbyor dum gcig sogs gang shes 'dzin la khyer kha med na'ang*/ sgyid lug ma byas par dka' ba spyad de bslabs/ khyod 'dzin yangs dum pa 'dug /slob gnyer byed pa la rtsam pa skyel mkhan dang gegs med par byas chog pa rnams 'bul rgyu yin/ nga 'dra ba shi nas dgon khog 'di tsho 'dzin pa dang*/ m-i'i sna ngos bstun bstun gyis mi 'ong gsungs pas bdag la ji ltar gsung gsung pa bzhin byung*/ da nyams len mdzad tshul ni khyed sgom byed 'dod na 'di 'dra bas mi yong*/

nged tsho dang po chos la blo song tsa na spyir gyis chos sgor zhugs nas dgon pa dang ma bral tsam du byas dus gal te klungs su phyin na'ang*/ khyim pa'i nang du mi 'gro bar zhag re tsam lus na'ang cog pu sogs 'gel bar sdod pa/ khyad par byams sding*/ zhul gang po/ rdza spa ོ mtho/ tshal min ri khrod/ dpal sdings kyi sangs rgyas sgom khong*/ ri bo bsam gtan gling*/ chos lung gi brag phug zhar ma/ yang rdzong lhan rdzong*/ spang po sdings/ ri bo bde chen la sogs te bla ma gong ma'i sgrub gnas dang ri brag rnams su gos ben dug dang*/ khyi thul re dang*/ ras rkyang byas dus ras la brten/ lto 'brul/ rtag tu ngu*/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ dbang lag/chu sogs la brten/ dka' thub bcud len ma byas dus/ rgyags la sris sri yags byas nas mun khang 'dag 'byar/ ri mi 'bebs thab spangs la sogs mang du byas pa yin/ chos byed pa la lto gos la gyong re tsam 'gel dgos pa yin/ khyed tshos dka' thub sogs ci'ang*/ chos nyan pa'i dus 'dir de ring gi gro'i rkyen mi theg par chos thun che tsam byung na nga la 'thabs tshad tshad yod par 'dug /de la byang kha ba 'di tsho thabs rdugs par 'dug /de 'dras mi yong*/ gong gi bzhin dgos pa yin gsung*/ nga dang po nas dka' thub sogs byed pa la blo 'gro bas gzhan gyis byed kyi zer ba la 'gran sems skyes pas/ grogs mched gcig bdud rtsi ril bu byed zer ba thos pas nga rang yang za dgos/ de ring rang tshod gcig lta bsam nas nged rang gi dri ma gcig btang nas de la g.yam pa'i thur ma btsug gyur mid byas pas/ 'di la sman sogs sbyar bas bzhin te zhim bsam spro ba skyes gsung*/ rting du bcud len sogs kyi lung thob nas/ zhul ra rgyud phyi'i bsnyen par byed pa'i ril bu byas

/ zas gzhan gyi 'khri ba bcad nas/ sngon tu zla ba drug /rting du zla ba bzhi byas pas shin tu 'jam par byung*/ byams ldi ngas su dbyar zla ba drug thab spangs byas/ rtsam khal phyed dang gnyis la brten nas/ dge sbyor smar bar byung*/ yang byams ldi ngas su lo mtshams gcig gi khongs su/ rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub mchod bsnyen pa byas pas bar chad kyi snang ba du ma zhig byung ba bskyed rim dang lta bas zin te dge sbyor gya ི grogs su song ba byung ba dge sbyor 'phel bar byung gsung / de la sogs te byams sdings su snga phyi dril bas lo bzhi lnga tsam mtshams byas bsdad pas skyid par byung gsung*/ tshal min ri khrod du mun khang byas dus rtogs ldan chos dpal dang lhan cig tu phyi sgo gcig /nang sgo tha dad du yod pas khong nyams gcig 'ur bas des rkyen byas nged rang yang 'ur bas rdo chung chig brtsegs byas pa'i bla g.yel de'i rtsig khar rgyug pas rdo brul/ nged rang gnyis ma 'gyel bas mi rnams kyis ya mtshan tsam byas/ gzhan yang sbyor drug gi rtags rnams legs po rang byung gsung*/ dpal ldan sdings su a khu bkras dpal gyis gong gi sa phug dang dbyar gcig zla ba gsum zan skam rkyal rlid gang la brten nas/ lcang lhab la zan skam rdaug po dang por bdun ma btab/ de nas snga ma de la zhag re byas bsdad pas nyams rtogs kyi shul dum pa byung*/ yid kyang stong pa 'dra bas dbyar ni lo ma dang zan skams 'dis chog /dgun ni 'bru ma ril bu sogs byas chog /dge sbyor sogs ni 'phel bar 'dug /bsod snyoms sogs lto gos kyi 'dun ma mi byed par/ dge sbyor kho nas dus 'das pa byed bsam byung gsung*/ brag phug zhar mi shar der ras pa bsam she dang nged grogs mched gnyis kyis bsdad/ 'bru chan byas nas bre gsum la zla ba gsum thub pa'i rtsis byas pas khong bcud len zla ba gcig bsdad/ ngas chan thur ma re 'gams pas chan phor ba gang gi rgyags lhag yang byung*/

dge sbyor yang 'phel ba rang gcig byung*/ nged gnyis kyi brag skyibs chung bas/ shing thog skal ba la thigs pa byung ba la len du phyin/ khong gi 'dug sa la yang yod tshad 'dug / phad chung gcig sas bkang khyer te shod de nas thogs der skyu ra bas rang re'i 'di 'dra 'jigs/ khyed rang gi chos yong ba 'dug /nga 'dras mi yong pa 'dug gsung byung*/ chos rje dkon rdor pa la ras chung snyan brgyud dang*/ gtum mo gsang sgrub kyi sgo nas ras rkyang zhus/ ri bor lo sar zla ba'i grang sgang la kha nas lud pa 'dor dus nam mkha' la 'chags te/ sa la 'thor 'gro ba'i dus der nged grogs mched gsum bzhi zhig gis ras 'bud byas/ nged gnyis drag pa byung ste/ drod kyis ras thub pa byung bas rtsa bzang gsung chos rje yang mnyes pa tsam byung*/ de nas bzung te 'khrul 'khor gyi khrigs ma chags par byas pas/ lus sngar dang yang mi 'dra bar yang ba sogs yon tan dum pa byung*/ rting du chos drug gi phyi nang gsang ba' ི 'khrul 'khor nyi shu/ lam 'bras kyi 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sba bzhi 'chi med 'khrul 'khor sogs ma chags par byas pas/ bogs cher 'phel bas yid ches te byad spro bar byung gsung*/ spangs po sdings na chos rje pa stod lung du/ bla ma gcig gi chos zhur gdan 'dren du byung bas chos bka' mang du zhu sgros su 'dug pas/ phyags phyir bdag kyang 'khrid par zhus pas chos la tshud de/ gzhi bal gzan pas bsdad pa 'thad gsung*/ chos la tshud na gzhi pa'i chu de 'thung dgos pa 'dra/ gzhan thigs ma gcig mi za bar dam bca' 'bul/ nged rang la gser 'dab gcig kyang yod/ bdud rtsi ril bu rkyal chung gang yang yod/ khar song nas kyang ril bu byas pa/ 'di gnyis zad nas gtor cha ting shags kyang yod/ cis kyang 'khrid par zhus pas/ 'o na gzhan mas mig ltos longs khyed rang sngon la song la ngas sgug sdod gyis gsung*/ gzhan mas ma tshor tsam byas phyin nas/

ngas pas khal phyed dang gnyis tshod gcig byung*/ de la gzhi ma byas ril bu yang dum pa zos/ gser de nad pa des nyos/ chos kyi dgos cha byas/ chos thob che ba yang byung*/ ril bu za ba gzhan gyi sa tshor bas bkres mthong gi dum pa ltar ba yang byung bas rgyags kyang med par yang byung gsung*/ chos zhu ba la yang rgyags sogs ma thogs khyer rgyu'am/ lto gos la gyong thub pa dka' ba der 'dug /ngas ni lto gos sogs yod na khyer med na gang byung la brten lo nyi shu rtsa gsum nas bzhi bcu zhe gsum bar dpal ldan sdings kyi dgon pa ma byung ring sprang po rgyal khams pa byas/ bla ma rnams dang mjal thub tshad mjal gdams ngag zhu thub tshad zhus/ nyams su blangs pa de sgom thub tshad bsgoms/ mdor na lto gang byung gos ral rkyang*/ de min khyi thul la brten pas bla ma rnams thugs la 'dogs pa/ chos dbang thob che ba/ grogs mched rnams dang mthun pa/ drag zhan nye ring su la'ang bstun mi dgos pa/ gang du bsdad kyang chags sdang mi dgos pas/ dge sbyor 'phel ba skyid pa rang byung gsung*/ dpal ldan sdings kyi bla ma 'di byas nas byed dka' ru song nas dpon po sogs drag zhan gyi sems 'dzin/ grwa pa dmu rgod kyi log sgrub /grogs po mnyam mnyam gyis mtho gnon/ sha tsha g.yog byed kyi sna ngur/ yon bdag pho mo'i byon gshegs/ yul mi ngan pa rnams kyis 'tshe ba sogs ma skyid pa'i mgo dang po 'dres byung*/ chos sogs zhu yang bla ma'i ming 'dra ba des mi re dgu re che bas dka' ba tsam byung ste/ bla ma tshur dgon par gdan 'dren pa/ phar nged rang 'gro ba sogs stabs gang 'grigs byas nas/ grwa bu slob dang yon bdag pho mo rnams la yang phan pa dang*/ zhar la tshangs par byas pa yin gsung*/ khyed rang tshong la gang yod 'di tshang mar zhus na des chog pa yod/ ngas khong pa 'di chos kyis tshil nag brkyangs pa bzhin byas nas yod pa yin te/

ched gnyer cher mi 'dug /de nas bla ma'i ming gog byas nas gzhan la zhu ba la rgyu cha rkyen mang du dgos/ dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzom pa yang dka' bas/ de las 'dir byas chog pa ni brod pa yin pas/ da lta zhu na dga' gsung*/ khyed rang tsho ro nyal nyal rang mi byed par rgyun du bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs re yang byed/ yi dam gyi lha gcig kyang gtso bor bzung ste bsnyen pa byed/ chos skyong gcig la gtor ma ma chags tsam re byed dgos pa yin/ nged ni tho rangs bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnal 'byor spyi 'dus re sgom/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lam zab bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ bi ma la'i gsol 'debs/ sku bzhi'i gsol 'debs pho nya myur mgyogs/ rang gi blos byas pa'i gsol 'debs/ brgyud pa gang nas brgyud pa'i chos de 'chad dus dang*/ sgom dus de'i gsol 'debs ma chags tsam byas pas/ bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ lus sems bde ba dang chos re tsam bshad kyang bar chad nyung tsam byung*/ slob ma yang sgom pa rnams la blo yul du babs nas phan pa yang dum pa byung bas/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i yon tan yin bsam pa yod gsung*/ dang po gu ru drag sgrub/ phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya/ khros nag /rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa/ rta mgrin lcags ral can la sogs pa drag po'i lha mang du bsgrubs pas rtags thon pa byung*/ rgyal po la sogs gnod pa la drag sgrub 'di bsngags par 'dug pas/ da lta bskrad pa sogs byed pa ni de yin gsung*/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dbang dang lung rnams thob nas grangs bsnyen dang de nas zhag re bzhin yi ge bdun ma khri tsho re/ gzhan ma gang lcogs re/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma la khri tsho re/ lha dgu'i snying po dang yang snying la khri tsho re/ gzungs gang lcogs re de bar bsgrangs pas byin rlabs zhugs pa 'dra yang byung*/ khyad par du pho lo bdun cu la zin 'dug

/ bar du nad drag po gnyis gsum byung ste rkyen byas nas mi shi bar bsdad chog pa yi dam rnams kyi thugs rje yin gsung*/ chos skyong yang dam can sde lnga la bskang gso dang*/ rgyun gtor byas pas rang la yang 'khor ba dang*/ chos 'chad dus longs spyod re tsam 'du ba'i yon tan dang*/ gnod pa re tsam byung na ma 'bad kyang rtags re yong ba 'dra 'dug /gza'i sgo nas nad pa'i gtor ma re tsam byas pas phan par byung*/ khyod rang yang 'di'i tshig brgyud ma 'di nyon ster ba yin gsung*/ ni gu dang 'brel nas mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas la gtor ma dang bsnyen pa yang du mar byas par bar chad re tsam sel ba'i rnam pa dang*/ rmi lam du yang snang ba thob pa'i rnam pa byung gsung*/ dgon gog 'dzin pa dang chos re tsam 'chad slob ma re tsam pa'i mi yin na/ chos skyong rnams la gtor ma re byed pa ni dgos byed chen po'i rigs su 'dug / mthu rang mi byed kyang lcags ri dang*/ chos 'chad dus ye shes pa rnams gtor mas mnyes par byas pas bar chad sel ba a cang che ste/ de rnams kyi 'khor gyi 'jig rten pa tsho ma mgu na'ang bar chad byed pa gcig yin par 'dug /nga dpal sdings su lo gnyis gsum du byas pas khrid pa yang mang du byung*/ de'i nang nas mun khang la nan tan byas pas mtshams byed pa dang*/ rtags than thun byung ba yang mang du byung bas phan pa yang cher byung*/ lo steng gcig byas pas khrid pa mang po byung*/ nyin gcig grags pa dpal ldan la jo nang bstan ma yin zer ba zhig babs pa 'dra 'dug pas/ khyod kyis sang la gtor ma la ched gnyer ma byas ngas 'bungs pa yin zer nas nged rang gis kyang ched gnyer yang che chung byas/ kha la nga khyod 'dras ma 'bungs kyang ma 'bungs byas pas/ de ka yin nga 'gro khyod kyis gyis zer bas/ de'i ras legs po byung na'ang steng du sbyor drug ye ma tshugs par lo mang po song rjes byas pas 'dzer ba tsam byung bas/

des na khyed tsho yang chos re tsam 'chad pa byung na gtor ma la nan tan re tsam dgos par 'dug gsung*/ drug pa ltar na nged rang gis bzungs pa'i dgon pa bzhi pa'i grwa pa bgres gzhon gcong can nyams chung yan gtso bor chos kyis bskyangs te khrid kha re tsam tshugs par byas/ lung phran dbang sogs gang dgos kyi sgo nas phan sems ma dor bar byas pa yin gsung*/ gzhan yang chos kyi phan pa sna re tsam byas/ sman dang sman dpyad gang shes 'dis nad pa sogs la gang phan byas/ mdor na tshe 'das gcig gi cho ga dbang bskur la phyin kyang 'di ngas cis kyang 'drongs par byed pa'i bsam pas byed pa yin/ de 'dra'i don byed pa la bsam pa de ci na sa kyang gtso che ba yin rigs su 'dug /pha jo phur bkra 'das nas bdun tshigs kyi chas mtshon pa gcig shul ma rnams kyis bskyal khyed rang gi a khu pha jo 'das/ khyed kyis 'bungs zer bas de tsug byed byas/ rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub mchod btsugs 'dun pa drag po byas pas/ rmi lam la pha jo mi gzhan zhig gi zla la mun nag yod pa'i mtha' 'dra zhig la song bas/ ngas ri rtse zhig la khrid bde ba can gyi lam bstan pas/ de phyogs la 'phur snyam phyed pa zhig byung*/ gzhan yang blo bzang po 'ga' re la byung gsung*/ mdor na bstan pa a cang che/ gzhan ma mi dang grog sbu ra yan la zan kham bu re sogs kyis phan na bsam pa byas/ nged rang sangs rgyas sgrub pa la sdig pa yang chung ngus gnod/ dge ba yang chung ngus phan pa yin/ khyed rang tsho yang phor pa gang gi steng nas kyang phud kyis dkon mchog mchod/ lhag de nas khyi zan bcangs pa re byed dgos pa yin gsungs/ bdun pa ltar na gzugs can gzugs med kyi lha 'dre glo bur gyi lha 'dre sogs kyis cher ma tshugs/ bya btang byas dus lam dgra dang jag pa byung ba mang ste/ dgra byed pa tshur byung ste phar gzan bkal ba rkyang yin/ dgon pa rnams bzung nas snyam chung la gnod pa re tsam dang*/

rkun ma re tsam byung ba rnams mthu gtad ngan pa ma byas kyang*/ thabs gang mkhas kyi sgo nas btul bas/ phar zhwa rang 'bud mi dgos pa 'di yin gsung*/ ngan pa rang byas pa zhig la gtor ma sogs ma byas kyang chos skyong rnams kyis shags 'byed re tsam byung ba 'ga' re byung gsung*/ byams sdings su rgyud sde lnga'i bsnyen pa byas dus spyil po de'i sgo de mtho ba ོ ra 'dug ste nang btsun pa 'dra ba'i gdong mchu dmar zhing ras kyam dang zhwa thebs gyon pa'i gzugs nam mkha' la snyegs pa zhig gnyid la song ba'i rmi lam du 'dug pas/ dang po skrags da ngangs kyang byung*/ de nas drag sgrub kyi bskyed rim 'khos che ba tsam du byas/ rmi lam de yang zin byung bas bden med kyi lta bas kyang zin/ gnyid sad dus nang de 'od gsal du mer re 'dug /de kha'i ngang du bzhag pas phyi snang ba thams cad kyang 'od gsal du song bsam pa'i nyams zhig byung nas/ bden med kyi tshig mang po kha nas 'don/ lus gar thabs su byed pa'i yun ring du 'khrab pa zhig byung gsung*/ dpal lda ིngas su mtshams gcig kyang byas/ dpe cha 'dra ba bzhengs byed kyi gzims khang du dbyar zha ི ga der bsdad tsa na thog smad dgu bab pa nged rang nyal yod pa'i thog gong ma nged rang gi thad de kha yin par 'dug /nyal ba'i steng gi thog de nas 'dam do tsam 'khyog 'dug pas bab dus yug gcig brgya 'dug / de nas gzha ོ ba dri dang ma ེ dri chen po 'dug song de'i khang pa de'i bzhi thog phug /mdzo mo zhig dang ba chung zha ི ga sha ི / rang la cang ma byung bas rting du 'jigs pa tsam gyis dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin par go /de nas gnang gzhis tsam la bu 'dren 'dzam zer ba zha ི ga yar kha na yod pa de la o rgyan gyi mchod gnas rgya mtsho 'bebs kyi yod pas mo bab nas/ dgon pa'i slob dpon ya gi dang lha 'dre rnams 'khrug pas slob dpon rgyal zer ba byung gsung*/ sdings po cher khrid gcig gtsugs pas khrid kyi sgang rang la song dus gdan la bzhugs pa la skrang 'bur zhig byung nas zug chen po rang byas

/ sdod pa la'ang chos thun gyi tsher zug tshad byung bas/ sgrub pa mo g.yu gang ma na yod pas/ nged na zer ba lab lab mang du byed pas/ rgya skad mang po lab byed pas/ khyod gang nas yin ci na byas pas/ rgya gar nas yin rdo rje gdan du tshogs 'khor la 'gro dgos pa yod/ nga 'gro zer nga la thug ste byas nas gcig pu na zer nas 'di la ci phan byas pas/ dam tshig gi sel dum tsam pa zhig gis len pa yin/ da chos nyan 'di tsho la yams rims sha ི ga yong ba yod/ de nas drag 'gro a'u tsa ི / chos shod 'phrin las 'dra byed zer ba byung gsung*/ yang sdings po che'i gzims khang de na glu bdud cig 'dug pas 'khor dang phyugs la gnod pa du ma re byas byung / nub gcig rmi lam na nyal ba'i steng gi gdung gseb de na sdig pa rtsig bu che shos tsam zhig 'dug pas rmi lam de zin byung ba dang*/ phag rgod mdzo tsam zhig tu sprul nas khyur mid byas pas rmi lam 'tshub pa dang gnod pa rnams chad byung*/ gzhan yang de 'dra'i rigs mang du gsung pa rnams dran pa ra ri tsam las mi gsal bar 'dug pas ma bris pa lags/ byams sdings su mun khang dang thab spangs dbyar gcig byas/ de thon rting lus thams cad sbrid pa dang*/ mig dmar por song rtsa chur yang 'gyur byung bas/ brtag pa byas dus mdze rang du shes byung*/ da de yang na rgyal khams la phyin rgyus med kyi yul du lam zan la brten nas 'di thon na rab/ ma thon kyang dge sbyor gang nus byed/ yang na ni mi med pa'i ri khrod cig tu 'chi sa byed/ da nged rang mi khrod du mi tshud par 'dug bsam byung ba las/ snga sor 'di khar mtshams zhig bgyis dang bsams/ phyag rdor u tsar+ya'i bsnyen pa yang dum re byas/ rdzas chen rnams pags byug byas pas/ byug pa byas kyin lod du rang song byung*/ nga 'di 'dra srog la rgol bar 'dug bsam nas thal thul dang cher med gang yod rnams kyi mtho rtse zha

ི ga zhang po la bcol/ nga shi 'dug zer na 'di tsho thong zer ba byas/ lus ngag khyer rgyal khams la phyin/ lha rje'i gral skor gcig byas nas 'chos shes pa yong ba yang srid/ klu sogs kyi gnod pa yin na/ gnyan sa gang 'dug tu gcod re tsam byas na thon pa yang srid bsam/ gal te ma thon kyang dge sbyor gang 'phel byed/ shi yang la kha'i bya ro dang chu kha'i nya ro byed bsam phyin pas/ lha rje la ci yin zer ba byas pas/ la la ci yin zer/ la la gang yin zer ba las/ things pa rang ma byung*/ dol gyi lcogs phug pas things te/ sa'i bam lus la rgyug pa yin/ mdze rang min mdze rtags tsam yin pas/ drag zer ba yin gsung pas/ nged rang gi yid yul dang mthun par byung*/ sa'i bam yin pa yang thab spangs byas dus sogs sne'i 'og de rul 'dug pas de go khong gi byug pa mang po yang bslab/ nged rang gis kyang drod bcos skor gyi byug pa byas/ rlung dang 'khrul 'khor mang du byas pas zla ba gcig nas skyed cher byung ste thon pa yin gsung*/ sdings po cher bla ma gad 'or bas dug cig byung ba las/ ma byung gong du rmi lam dang mo ma sogs kyis dug yod zer ba la/ nged rang rtog pa rtsings pas/ khos zho zhig la phye zhig btab nas byin pas/ pha rol la 'gro rtsis grabs byas/ gang yod la spang dag dang*/ dpal ldan sdings kyi tshad khang 'di yang bzhengs/ mi rnams phal cher lang 'chi byas/ khong rnams na re 'chi ba rang mi 'ong dug yin na a'i chu tshan phan zer bas 'gro dgos bsam yod pa la/ rmi lam la yang phyin na bsam pa zhig byung bar phyin pas nyes med du 'khor de nas chu tshan gyi yon tan dang dkon mchog gi thugs rje las nad kyang skyed cher byung*/ 'chi rtsis rang la ma shi tsam byung steng du dpal sdings su ske dang*/ khyad par lce kha'i nang du mi shongs tshad byas/ lab kyang ye mi shes pa zhig byung bas/ gzhan ma dang nged rang byings kyis 'chi bar gzung*/

lha rjes kyang thog der srin bya'i skad byung ba thos 'dug pa dang bcas pas/ lha rjes kha gtam de byas/ da dkon mchog min pa re sa med bsam ste/ bla ma dkon mchog shi ba legs sam/ ma shi ba legs gang legs pa thugs rjes zung thugs rjes skyob pa'i dus su 'dug bsam nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ nam mkha' nas sgra byung ste dbang bzhi bskur ba rnams rims pa bzhin du/ dang po nyid dag pa bzhi'i dbang*/ gnyis pa ye shes rgyun mi chad pa'i dbang*/ gsum pa 'khor lo bde ba chen po'i dbang*/ bzhi pa dag pa ye shes kyi dbang zer ba byung*/ de'i go ba len gyin dbang zhig blangs/ de nas yug cig song ba na/ dus min 'chi bar mi 'gyur te/ / skyes bu'i tshe lo brgyad cu yin zer ra ོ/ / de nas yug bstan pa chags pa drug stong sum brgya yin/ gnas pa 'jig pa'ang drug stong brgya re yin/ zer ba yang byung bas yid nyams sos byung*/ byams sdings su thog 'og tu tshud/ yang kha'i gru yang bying la khad pa yang kha nas dgon par phyi phyi zhig 'ong bas/ lam 'a dzol ba kha 'dras byas/ gad pa rta zhon mdung bzung gyi tshod cig la thu+u la yug gcig brgyal dran pa byung ba dang nyams sha ི ga lhan cig byung 'dug pas de'i ngang la dgon par 'khyol 'dug /de nas nyams de sad tsa na tsug tsam mi yong par 'dug /de la sogs te rkyen drag po mang pos nged rang yang 'chi bar thag bcad pa mang po byung ste/ da tshun bla ma dkon mchog gi thug rjes legs po rang byung lags te/ de nas khos gcig skyal gsung*/ da lta'i mi 'di tsho na yang mi 'chi gzhan 'chi ba 'dug pa mthong yang nged rang mi 'chi bsam pa'i mi rigs mang po 'dug khyed rnams la bar thar yang e yong ngam/ da yang de 'dra'i grabs re tsam dgos pa yin gsung*/ brgyad pa ltar na sku na chung ngu'i dus su ma ṇi re tsam bgrangs pas/ brag 'bru gu gshongs kyi brag phug cig na thugs rje chen po'i sku ngo mtshar can zhig 'dug pa la phyag dang mchod pa byas pas/

byin gyis brlabs pa byung gsung*/ ral gri gong du 'u lag skyel phyin/ g.yul khang nang 'dra zhig tu bsdad/ o rgyan gyi rtags bstod cig shes pa mang du byas pas rmi lam du gu ru'i sku gcig nam mkha' de la bzhugs 'dug pa la gsol ba btab pas 'od zer gyi rnam pa nged rang la tshur byung nas/ de nas nam mkha' la je mthor song mi mthong ba tsam du yal bar rmis/ chu bo rir tshe chu la phyin pas/ lcang sar mda' nas/ srin po ri'i gtsug lag khang mthong byung bas/ bcom ldan 'das la dad pa gcig cher skyes/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa dang*/ kha nas gang shes kyi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas pas/ de dgongs gangs dkar zhol du bsdad pas/ rmi lam du sṛn po ri ngos la phyin pas/ gtsang po thon pa'i gling kha'i dkyil du slebs tsa na/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo gcig pa rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa sku mdog nam mkha' ltar dngas pa zhig dang mjal byung bas phyag dang skor ba mang du byas pas/ zhal nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba 'thung bas lus sems bde bas khyab pa rigs kyi bu zhes lan gsum byon pas gsung gi snang ba dang bcas pa byung gsung*/ dpal sdings dgon rtser phyag drug pa'i las byang gtor chog rgyas bsdus ran pa zhig byed dgos bsam pa yod pas dgongs shig rmi lam du ye shes mgon po'i sku shin tu che ba zhig byon/ las byang byed bsam na gyis gsung pa byung bas/ de nas byas chog par go nas byas pa yin gsung*/ dgu pa ltar na/ byis pa'i dus su yang kha'i rgyal sgo gdong du phyin pas/ bla ma dung long dang*/ ang ga rag gsol nas/ chang dang zam nor phran tshegs ldang la slong gsung*/ med zhus pas 'di na 'dug gzhan lugs 'di bzhin 'dug rdzun ma zer gsung*/ gang yod things pa'i mngon shes can cig byung bas/ nga gzigs 'phral du chos kyi skal ba bzang po yod/ chos gyis gsung ba byung gsung*/

'khrul zhig rin po che la gdams ngag re tsam zhus dus byed dgos/ khyed kyis 'gro don re tsam yong bar 'dug pas gsung*/ nged rang gi mgron po dang ci yong zhus pas/ de ring song tsa na yong ba yin blo ma lad par gyis la 'bungs gsung*/ cha ི ga brgyud kyis dbang rjes gnang sogs/ nye ra gnas dang mi gzhan sku mdun med dus shog gsung mang du gnang gsung*/ bya btang chos rjes gcig gnang ba'i rjes la ma ṇi brgya rtsa re bskul ba phyag lan du mdzad pa/ bdag la bla ma ras pa khyed dpal sdings su chos 'chad tsa na ma ṇi 'di bskul gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang khyod rang yang dgon pa 'dzin tsa na 'dug gyis gsung mang du gsungs pa/ nga 'dras dgon pa dang ci zin bsam pa las/ steng du dgon pa 'dzin lo chos 'chad lo re tsam byas dus/ drug pa nyid la mngon mkhyen zhig mnga' bar go gsung*/ chos kyi rje sa ma ṇi 'di khyed tshos kyang chos dang 'chad pa byung na gyis gsung*/ bcu pa ltar na/ lo gcig gnyis tsa na/ nga rgad po da lo song res kyi mi gsungs pa dang*/ chos bzhin zhu na da lta zhus pa drag /de nas nged kun e sdod mi shes gsung*/ nga shi na yang khyed rang spun gnyis 'di zung*/ spyad pa 'di tsho khyed rang tsho bdag rgyu yin/ 'di tsho rjes la gtong rgyu yin zer ba sogs mang du byon/ nyin gcig glo bur du nged ming sring rnams la 'di 'dra bdag rgyu yin gyi yi ge re mdzad nas 'di rnams khyed tshos gyis/ gzhan ma gang 'dug nga rang gi rjes la thong gsung*/ ngas phyogs gcig nas slebs dus yi ge rnams ston mdzad pa las/ blo dang ma bde bya ba ni med bsam pa zhig byung*/ de nas chos lung du dgun bi ma la'i khrid gnang ba las/ gnangs zhes tsam thon rgyu'i do dgongs der dzaṃ pa lha'i pha'i cho ga la theg pas/ kho dam nyams der song bas/ de'i skyon gyis de dgongs der shin tu snyung ste de khar 'grong 'dra bsam pa las/

ma grongs tsam la song dgon par phebs pa'i dgongs mo de ra / khro bo ri ri rti'i phyag rgya gyis bgegs bsrung ba yin gsung pa zhig byung gsung*/ yang yug gcig na/ mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po zhig byon da lo la mi 'chi tsam yong ba 'dra gsung*/ de res de gsol ba mi thebs la khad pa las/ bdag sogs la thugs rjes gzigs nas sku khams kyang dngas/ da zhag kyang chos lung du de'i dgun mkha' 'gro snying thig btsugs par cha ེ da kyang med/ bka' lung snying thig ma gnyis kyi lhag lus 'dra yod pa rnams kyang rdzogs par gnang*/ khyad par bka' sdod rjes gnang pod lung rnams thugs rjes bzung nas 'di tsho khyed spun la 'phrod pas blo bde gsung*/ bka' lung yang bzang po gnang*/ de nas dpyid kha da ེ ra chos lung nas sku khams mgo ma an tsam mnyel nas/ dpal sdings su phebs nas kyang mnyel ba zla ba gnyis tsam byung*/ de nas bdag gis sleb nas mnyel ba zla ba gcig lhag tsam gyi ring la/ lus tshags kyang 'grol rgyu med par bsnyung g.yog zhabs tog byas pas bsnyung zug chung ba'i bar la/ khrid 'di 'chad pa la 'di gyis gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par rdzogs chen chos brgyud yin pas/ gzhan tshos snying thig ma gnyis mkho ba yong pas 'di bzhin byed rgyu yin sogs mang du gnang*/ de nas spyir gyi grwa bu slob dang*/ dgos nged rang spun dang bcas pa'i bsod des ma zin pa'i rnam pas ma bzhugs par rig pas/ klungs la 'tshol 'tshol 'dra byed pa la phyin/ de dgongs slebs rtsis ma sleb pas/ blo dang ni bde don ma chod pa byas pas ni ma byung*/ de'i dgongs mo der gnyid cher ni ma byung*/ tho rangs rig pa gcig byung dus/ khyod rang ga le gyis drung pa lags/ sgug nas bzhugs yod zer bas sems mi 'tshab tsam byung*/ de nas de'i dgongs mo 'phyi gcig yar yong dus ma sleb gong du jo jo gsung pa mang du byon/ kho sleb ma byung ngam gsung pa byung 'dug de sleb dus ci 'dra byung zhes shod du dris pas ma thegs tsam byung zer bas yid kyang sos pa las/

sku mdun du sleb pas jo jo gsung pas lags zhus pas sleb pa dga' gsung*/ de nas cang mi gsung bar snyung zugs kyang chung du song bas thugs dam la bzhugs te/ yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i tho rangs gdul bya dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs pa las/ de nga 'dra ba'i mi'i bsod nams kyi skal pa thams cad dus 'dir nub song bsam ste/ yid pham yang cher skyes mchi ma sogs mang du byung ste/ a khu dge sbyong dang*/ zhang po blo rgyal gnyis la re ba byas nas ma byung pa/ tsug byas/ yid kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ smon lam mang du byas pa rnams zin pa dang*/ nam yang langs byung nas tshad pa yang tsha bas/ sku gdung de bzhugs lugs byas/ tsan dan ga pur gyis byug bdag gis byang khar phyin pas/ grab yul sogs kyi bsam blo dang blo gting nas kyang ma bde bas ma mthong bar 'dug sbyin pa sogs kyi ltas pa rnams kyis nam mkha'i gzhi ma dwangs pa la/ 'ja' sna lnga dang 'ja' dkar gyis khengs 'dug zer de ltar gshegs na'ang*/ thugs dgongs rdzogs thabs rnams sgrub pa la lag na 'don rgyu yang cher mi 'dug /gdan sa pa yang na/ sbyin pa yang stabs ma bde ba 'dras byas/ nged rang la yang mi'i khyer kha cher med pa'i steng du/ mi gcig lag gcig tu song byung na'ang*/ drung pa nyid kyi thugs rje la brten nas/ mi la ngo mi tsha tsam 'grub byung / lo dus su sku gdung de bzhu bas rten sogs ma byin yang*/ gdung lcags chod mang du byon/ de kha dang mtshungs par nang rten tshe dpag med cig bzhengs pas srog shing rang lugs su yod pa dang*/ mar me 'dzin pa sogs byon rting du byang chub chen po'i sku 'bum bzhengs dus/ yo byad sogs 'bad med byung ste/ rab gnas kyang shin tu legs te mthong ba'i yul phyogs kyang lau legs pa'i dge mtshan yang yod pa dang*/ dpal ldan sdings rang du yang byin rlabs che ba dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rtags mang du byung*/

khyad par bre'i nang na dbu thod ril por byon pa de rin po ches bkang nas yod pas de'i yon tan gyis dpal ldan sdings pa rnams yar 'phel rang la song byung ba thugs rje yin par 'dug /de la sogs te tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang yon tan mnga' ba'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid dag pa'i zhing khams gang du bzhugs kyang*/ spyir sems can thams cad dang khyad par nged rang la gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu slob rnams thugs rjes mi 'dor bar go ste/ bdag gis phyag rgya chen po'i chos de 'chad lo byas dus/ gzhan mas ma rig par 'dug /nga rang 'chad pa'i tshig sgros gcig la blo thengs pa las de dgongs de rmi lam du byon te/ 'di yin gsung pa dang gzhan yang dgon pa phan tshun du legs nyes re tsam yod na/ legs pa la dgyes pa dang*/ nyes pa la mi dgyes pa sogs rmi lam du yong ba 'dra 'dug pas/ des na gsol ba btab na thugs rjes 'bral med du gzigs par 'dug pas/ mos gus ltem rkyang med pa'i sgo nas/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa dang*/ gong du bkod pa'i che ba yon tan gyi rnam par thar pa rnams la yid ches shing sna re tsam las ma byung yang phyag len la thebs par mdzad par zhu zhu/ 'dir yang gsung pa rnams phal cher chos gnang dus gsung pa dang*/ dpon slob 'gol dus gsung pa dang*/ skabs gzhan du yang dam dum gsung pa rnams bdag gi dran pa la bzung bar bgyis te/ gsung ji lta ba bzhin la rang bzo'i legs legs 'dra'i lhan pa sogs kyis ma bslad par byas shing*/ dad can rnams dang ba 'dren byed dang*/ bdag nyid kyang bla ma dam pa rjes su dran pa'i yid gso ba'i phyir dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la rnam thar re mdzad par 'dug pas/ 'dir yang 'di lta bu zhig dgos par go nas bgyis pa lags pas/ mos gus can rnams bla ma'i phyag len la yid ches par bya ba'i phyir gzigs par zhu zhing*/ skabs gzhan du sgrib pa'i sa bon gsog pas dad pa tsam med pa la sba bar rigs so/

/ de las bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la mos pa can rnams dang ba 'dren pa'i gsung*/ me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i gdung 'dzin shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang rnam rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ stag gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gcig gi skar ma mgo'i nyin dga' ldan byams pa sdings kyi chos rje rin po che'i gzims khang dam par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo dang ldan pa'i 'jam dpal blo gros kyis so/ / 'dis kyang bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pa nyid du shes te/ phyam gcig par bla ma'i drin las ji lta bar rtogs pa nyid du gyur cig /bla ma'i rnam thar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /gang gsung cha shas rdzogs pa'i 'od zer de/ /bdag blo'i mkha' la shar te bkod pa las//dad ldan kun da'i tshal rnams dgyes par mdzod/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba rgya mtsho las/ /'gro kun bung ba chos kyis tshims byas nas/ /mthar yang bla ma'i go 'phang bsgrod par shog /gzhan yang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ / dam pas ma bzhin brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ /gang gsung sgrub byed thugs kyi bu gcig pu/ /dam chos nu

zhos ngoms pa nyid gyur cig /dge ba dang bde skyid ldan pa'i bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa mnga' bas phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (4)chos kyi rje mtshungs med grags pa rgya mtsho'i rnam thar me tog gi phreng ba/ -PAGE 284--PAGE 285--PAGE 278-
